title: SternKlinik (medi-z Bremen GmbH)
description: Multi-specialty medical centre in central Bremen. Combines orthodontics, orthopaedics, oral and maxillofacial surgery, dentistry, ENT, physiotherapy and an open 0.3 T MRI under one roof, across two sites. Around 30 staff, 15 physicians, roughly 6,200 active patient records. Operated by a single-managing-director GmbH; the orthodontic unit runs as a separate partnership, KFO Bremen GbR.*once the timer expires, the files will be available for sale — submit your request to the operator https://www.sternklinik.net
